games.title: Benevolink™: Actual Individual
games.subtitle: Where artificial hyper-intelligence meets actual underpaid individuals
games.description: A satirical WarioWare-style microgame collection built with pure modern ES Modules, HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, and the Web Audio API. Benevolink operates a planetary AI that claims 99.9% autonomy, but panics when it encounters everyday edge cases (ducks, holey socks, CAPTCHAs, smoking servers). Outsmart AI chaos with 2-5 second split-second micro-challenges, climb corporate ladder ranks, or get Promoted to Customer!
games.controls: Keyboard (A/D, Arrows, 1-9, Enter, Space) or Touch/Mouse
games.author: Josh Lyons
features: 8 Distinct Satirical Microgames (Autonomous Car, Sock Sorter, Titanic Cruise, Mars Rover, Captcha Overlord, etc.)
Procedural Synthesized Web Audio Engine with dynamic BGM tempo ramping
SpeechSynthesis Voice Narration and responsive PIP strike system
Dedicated Training / HR Practice Room simulator
